scope: Target only documented conflicts from existing batch 001–018 and current species files. No full re-extraction, general audit, BONAP, or county distribution work. Existing photographs and species JSON not changed.

baseline.status_note: README remains starter/staging; collection-index authority STAGING_ONLY. Research record is not an approved species.

resolved_conflicts.resolution: Keep accepted Grindelia ciliata (Nutt.) Spreng. Kew recognizes Grindelia papposa G.L.Nesom & Y.B.Suh and Prionopsis ciliata (Nutt.) Nutt. as homotypic synonyms; 1999 flora's G. papposa p.362 account may be used as historic concept with explicit original name and note that 1999 authors excluded an older application of Grindelia ciliata Spreng.
resolved_conflicts.resolution_scope: nomenclature only; species-wide morphology finalization pending

resolved_conflicts.resolution: Keep Iva asperifolia var. angustifolia (Nutt. ex DC.) B.L.Turner; the original flora's Iva angustifolia Nutt. ex DC. is a homotypic synonym. Original species treatment p.378 is linked explicitly to modern variety but not extrapolated to I. asperifolia broadly.

original_flora.name: Iva angustifolia Nutt. ex DC.
original_flora.diagnostic: Phyllaries united into toothed cup, linear-lanceolate leaves 2–5 cm by 2–12 mm; fruit black 2–2.8 mm, involucral width 2–3 mm.

evidence.status: opened, accepted variety and synonym confirmed

resolved_conflicts.resolution_scope: nomenclatural identity and regionally described traits

resolved_conflicts.resolution: Keep current Rudbeckia amplexicaulis Vahl; historical Dracopis amplexicaulis (Vahl) Cass. is a synonym. Preserve the 1999 Dracopis morphological treatment with its page provenance.

Keep accepted Liatris punctata Hook. at species level. Historical Liatris mucronata DC. belongs to Liatris punctata var. mucronata (DC.) B.L.Turner; old 1999 L. mucronata p.384 description must be variety-scoped, not propagated to all L. punctata.

Keep modern Solidago altissima distinct from modern Solidago canadensis. The original flora's S. canadensis var. scabra at p.410 maps specifically to Solidago altissima subsp. altissima per Kew/FNA, not to all S. altissima and not to subsp. gilvocanescens.

evidence.status: opened, synonym of Solidago altissima subsp. altissima confirmed

resolved_conflicts.kind: historical Wedelia texana name versus modern accepted variety
resolved_conflicts.resolution: Retain Wedelia acapulcensis var. hispida (Kunth) Strother as accepted Kew taxon. Kew lists Wedelia texana (Torr. & A.Gray) B.L.Turner and Zexmenia texana A.Gray in its synonymy. Preserve the 1999 Flora p.430 note that its use of Wedelia texana was not equivalent to some older misapplications of W. acapulcensis var. hispida; synonymy does not approve every historic photo/specimen concept.

evidence.status: opened: accepted variety and older names confirmed

resolved_conflicts.resolution: Replace claimed categorical 'strongly recurved phyllaries' with source-specific 'weakly spreading to appressed; apices straight, incurved, or only slightly recurved'. Keep strongly recurved phyllaries out of definitive diagnostic teaching for this species.

original_flora.name: Grindelia lanceolata
original_flora.note: Phyllaries ascending to spreading, not squarrose/reflexed in regional key

evidence.status: FNA indexed species text verified; full page unavailable

outstanding_conflicts.issue: Original 1999 flora says glandular pubescence usually absent, whereas learner says glandular-hairy stems; FNA reports often hirtellous/scabridulous and gland-pitted leaves and variable phyllaries. Different organ/indumentum definitions may explain part; specimen-level hair assertions not yet resolved.
outstanding_conflicts.hold: Do not approve stem glandular-hair as definitive until organ-specific evidence.

outstanding_conflicts.issue: FNA states species may not be distinct from G. pulchella at species rank.
outstanding_conflicts.hold: Accepted species rank and photo identity not finalized.

outstanding_conflicts.issue: Original 1999 Aster eulae p.320–322 discusses hybrid versus separate species and resemblance to S. praealtum.
outstanding_conflicts.hold: Taxon rank/parentage and diagnostic photos not finalized.

outstanding_conflicts.issue: 1999 flora recognizes T. ambiguum as species and brackets variety combination; modern variety-level traits not independently verified.
outstanding_conflicts.hold: Keep rank and infraspecific metrics provisional.

outstanding_conflicts.issue: 1999 T. scaposa p.420 account is species-level and not separately diagnostic for var. scaposa.
outstanding_conflicts.hold: Do not characterize modern variety as measured by species-level original account.

outstanding_conflicts.issue: 1999 p.415 only notes S. sempervirens var. mexicana under broad species; modern S. mexicana species morphology not established from it.
Seasonal morphology and FNA subspecies phyllary tuft overlap; spring plants of subsp. subaxillaris may lack tuft, so a tuft-absent photo cannot reliably assign subsp. latifolia.

Although accepted-name synonymy is established, historical 1999 p.362 explicitly includes an exclusion 'not Grindelia ciliata Spreng.'; authorship/use needs nomenclatural interpretation before reusing older labeled imagery without specimen verification.
outstanding_conflicts.hold: Historic photograph re-labeling/specimen identity only; not synonym validity.
